rank_math.description: Window glass replacement across the GTA: shattered, cracked, or failed panes swapped into your frame, or a new unit installed. Same or next day, warrantied.

fields.hero_h1: Window Glass Replacement in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Shattered, cracked, or failed glass? We swap the unit into your existing frame, or install a new window when that is the better call. Same or next day.
fields.overview_body:
When a pane is shattered, cracked through, or the seal is gone, you usually replace the glass, not the whole window. SolidGuard does window glass replacement across Toronto and the GTA: where the frame is sound, we replace just the glass unit, which is faster and usually less than a new window.

From a single cracked pane to a full window pane replacement, we match the glass to your home: double-pane, triple-pane, tempered safety glass, or low-E with argon for efficiency. Need to replace window glass fast? Our window glass replacement is usually same or next day, with police-cleared technicians and a workmanship warranty. When the frame itself is past saving, we supply and install a new window.
fields.repairfirst_body: Before we replace anything, we check whether a repair will do. If it will, we say so, because it saves you money. When replacement is genuinely the right call, that is when we replace.

faqs.question: Do you replace just the glass or the whole window?
faqs.answer: If the frame is sound we replace just the glass unit, which is faster and usually less than a full window. When the frame is past saving, we supply and install a new window.

faqs.question: How much does window glass replacement cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on the size and type of glass. We give you a firm quote before any work, with no charge until you approve it. For typical ranges, try our cost estimator.

faqs.question: What kind of glass can you install?
faqs.answer: Double-pane, triple-pane, tempered safety glass, and low-E units with argon for better efficiency. We match the new glass to what your window was built for.

faqs.question: Can you replace a single cracked pane in a double-pane window?
faqs.answer: A double-pane window is one sealed unit, so we replace the whole unit, not a single layer. It slots into your existing frame, so the frame and trim stay put.

faqs.question: How fast can you come out?
faqs.answer: Same or next day across most of the GTA. If the opening is unsafe, tell us and we will prioritize it.

faqs.question: Is the replacement guaranteed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every job carries a workmanship warranty, and if something is not right we come back and make it right.
